title: 69 Fairview Close, Ballybough, Dublin 3, D03A1H8
description:
LEONARD WILSON KEENAN
ESTATE & LETTING AGENTS 
Our business is you ....

BREATHTAKING 3 BED / 3 BATH DUPLEX HOME OF DISTINCTION 
STUNNING INTERIOR
EXTRA SPACIOUS FLOOR PLAN

TWO LARGE SOUTH FACING TERRACES
MOST SOUGHT AFTER DEVELOPMENT OF HOMES

EARLY VIEWING STRONGLY ADVISED

A most unique city home....

Multi Award Winning Team Patrick Leonard The Fairview Property Specialists are truly delighted to present this most unique home to the Dublin 3 property market. Modern properties boasting a spacious floor plan together with an excellent energy rating are rare to come to market.

No. 69 will appeal to first time buyers, professionals, families, parties trading up / down and investors alike.

No. 69 offers a peaceful secluded setting with an array of amenities on your doorstep, yet the city is within close proximity.

The floor plan which is flooded with natural light comprises of: Hallway, bedroom / study, large living / dining room, kitchen & guest toilet. Upstairs there are 2 large bedrooms (one with en suite and primary bedroom has Jack and Jill bathroom with additional access from the landing).

The features of this most captivating home include: Quality flooring throughout, bespoke fitted kitchen with an abundance of base and eye level storage to include integrated high end appliances, quality tiling and sanitary ware in all bathrooms, large south facing terrace off living / dining room and large south facing terrace off primary bedroom.

The property also features double glazed windows.

The location is second to none within close proximity of a wealth of local amenities. Drumcondra, Croke Parl, Clontarf, Fairview, Marino, East Point & East Wall are all on your doorstep.

Early viewing is strongly advised.
